summary: Reference sheet for Recovery Bouncer, the Club DB security lead responsible for safe rollback and system recovery. Shows four approved poses (neutral standing, stop/rejected, approve/safe to recover, recovery plan/checklist) with signature props and how-to-draw guidance.

character: Recovery Bouncer is a heavyset, bald security lead with a large dark beard and black sunglasses.
He holds rollback authority and protects the club by restoring systems safely and reliably.
costume: Black short-sleeved Club DB security polo shirt with a blue and white Recovery role badge on the left chest.
Black trousers and a black belt with a rectangular silver buckle.
Black sunglasses and a large dark beard.
signature_props: Recovery Plan clipboard or folder with 'RECOVERY PLAN' text on the cover.
Recovery icons: backup, rollback, restore, replay (circular icons with arrow and play symbols).
Recovery role badge (shield with database symbol).
poses: 1 NEUTRAL STANDING: arms crossed, holding the Recovery Plan clipboard.
2 STOP / REJECTED: right hand raised in a stop gesture, left hand on hip.
3 APPROVE / SAFE TO RECOVER: right thumb up, left hand on hip.
4 RECOVERY PLAN / CHECKLIST: holding the clipboard showing checked items: BACKUP, ROLLBACK, RESTORE, REPLAY.
colors: Black uniform as the dominant color.
Blue and white badge and accent colors.
Tan clipboard with black text and green check marks.
Off-white/cream background with subtle panel borders.
style: Clean editorial cartoon illustration with bold outlines.
Simplified vector-adjacent finish with consistent proportions across the four poses.
guidance_notes: Biggest build in the group - broad, heavyset, and powerful.
Steady, grounded stance with squared shoulders.
Protective authority - calm, confident, and in control.
Keep sunglasses, beard, and badge consistent.
Always include a clear recovery-plan prop (clipboard or checklist) in at least one pose.

positive_constraints: Preserve the heavyset, bald build with large dark beard and black sunglasses in every depiction.
Keep the black Club DB security polo and Recovery role badge.
Maintain the black trousers, black belt with rectangular silver buckle, and black shoes.
Include a clear recovery-plan prop (clipboard or checklist) in at least one pose.
Keep the four approved poses: neutral standing, stop/rejected, approve/safe to recover, recovery plan/checklist.
Use the approved color palette: black uniform, warm skin tone, blue and white badge accents, tan clipboard, green check marks.
Use this image as the canonical reference for Recovery Bouncer's proportions, costume, and props.
negative_constraints: Do not make Recovery Bouncer slim, hairy, or without a beard.
Do not remove or change the black sunglasses.
Do not replace the Club DB security polo with casual clothing.
Do not omit the Recovery role badge from the chest.
Do not replace the recovery-plan clipboard with unrelated props.
Do not change the checked recovery steps (BACKUP, ROLLBACK, RESTORE, REPLAY) to different wording.
Do not add busy backgrounds or extra characters to the reference poses.
